settings.description: The largest one version of an artifact may be, in bytes. A model that writes a larger one is told so and nothing is kept.
How many of an artifact's newest versions are kept. Zero keeps every version. When a new version would pass the number, the oldest is removed, and the newest is never removed.
The most characters an artifact's title may have.

What an artifact's sandboxed frame may do, as sandbox permissions separated by spaces, from allow-scripts, allow-forms, allow-modals, allow-downloads and allow-pointer-lock. Same-origin, top navigation and popups are never allowed, whatever this says. Without allow-scripts, HTML runs no script and React and Mermaid artifacts are not drawn.
